description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for Orleans transaction fault testing using xUnit. It extends a base test runner and provides specific test methods with different data inputs, utilizing xUnit attributes for parameterized testing and skipping certain tests due to known issues.

classes.name: TocFaultTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending the base transaction test runner, specialized for xUnit testing framework, providing specific test method implementations with data-driven tests.
